A 2% solution in water has a pH of 4.0 to 5.0. USP 31 (Mepivacaine Hydrochloride). A white, odourless, crys- talline solid. Freely soluble in water and in methyl alcohol; very slightly soluble in chloroform; practically insoluble in ether. A 2% solution in water has a pH of about 4.5. pH of solutions.
